motivation: R v1 user-supplied official feedback: attack power 0.169387840941965; large mock-to-official gap, especially AIA. Compare public geometry without a release-style classifier and soft cross-target MIA correction. Do not fit to the aggregate official score.
scoring: Pinned official score_attack on each complete 22-target world; estimate each mock AIA floor with 1000 official reference draws, shared across candidates. Include all targets and independent releases.
selection: Choose MIA and AIA separately by mean corrected component score across both development worlds. Eligible candidates cannot lose more than 0.03 in either world or 0.10 in any pooled release-style mean relative to R v1. Require mean improvement greater than 0.005; otherwise preserve that baseline component. Prefer listed-first in a tie. Freeze selection and source hashes before confirmation; do not reselect using confirmation.
limitations: Mock generator and people partitions have already been used; new seeds are not unseen real people.
Profiles are sensitivity scenarios, not estimates of actual defenses.
Official hidden truth/floors are unavailable. A higher mock score does not establish a higher official score.
